description.value: Henderson Recreation Centre is a public sports and recreation facility operated by the District of Oak Bay, serving the Oak Bay municipality within Greater Victoria. It offers registered programs, drop-in activities, and various recreational facilities for community members and visitors. As a publicly run sports centre in an urban cycling area, it may offer amenities useful to touring cyclists, though these could not be confirmed from available content.
